'''Japan''' is an island country in East Asia.

== Regions ==
* [[Kanto]]
* [[Kansai]]

== Cities ==
* [[Tokyo]]
* [[Kyoto]]

== Understand ==
=== History ===
Japan's recorded history spans more than a millennium.

=== Culture ===
Seasonal festivals and temple visits shape travel.

=== Climate ===
Cherry blossom season is usually late March to early April.

== Get in ==
=== Transit without a visa (TWOV) ===
Some nationalities can transit without a visa.

== Get around ==
The shinkansen connects major cities.

== Stay safe ==
Japan is generally safe for visitors.

== Respect ==
Remove shoes when entering homes and many traditional inns.

== Connect ==
Prepaid SIMs and eSIMs are widely available.
